  "title": "Add Bidder query params to the cookiesync script",
  "body": "As described by https://github.com/prebid/prebid-server/issues/490, this cookiesync script will break GDPR in AMP pages if used [in the normal documented way](http://prebid.org/dev-docs/show-prebid-ads-on-amp-pages.html#user-sync).\r\n\r\nTo fix this, we need:\r\n\r\n1. The cookiesync script to accept bidder params in the query string, so they can be used in the `amp-iframe`\r\n2. Use these bidders in the `/cookie_sync` call, as documented [here](https://github.com/prebid/prebid-server/blob/master/docs/endpoints/cookieSync.md).\r\n3. Update [the docs](http://prebid.org/dev-docs/show-prebid-ads-on-amp-pages.html#user-sync) to show publishers how to do it.",
